statement_en: A real sequence $x_n$ converges to a real number $x$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$, $$|x_n-x_m|<\varepsilon.$$
prerequisites: definition of convergence of a sequence
callout_body: 实数列$x_n$收敛到实数$x$，当且仅当对于任意$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$都成立$$|x_n-x_m|<\varepsilon$$
